name: 3pika Gallery – Filterable Photo Gallery & Lightbox
author: 3pika

sections.description:
3pika Gallery lets you build beautiful, fast, filterable galleries in minutes:

  • Create galleries from the 3pika Gallery menu, add images from the Media Library, drag & drop to reorder.
  • Filters: create categories with their own colors, assign images (bulk assign supported) and let visitors filter with one click. Unlimited filters, 8 filter styles (buttons, pills, square, soft, outline, underline, text, dropdown) and 6 mobile layouts.
  • Layouts: Grid, Mosaic and List.
  • Responsive columns: 1 to 6 columns on desktop, tablet and mobile are calculated automatically (or set them yourself).
  • Lightbox with swipe, keyboard navigation, captions and counter.
  • Pagination: page numbers or “Load more”.
  • Hover effects and hover icons, captions on hover or below, corner radius per corner, gaps, accent color.
  • Works everywhere: shortcode, Elementor widget, WPBakery element, Gutenberg block, Classic Editor button, PHP template tag.
  • 85 languages: the plugin follows the language of your site.
  • No jQuery on the front end, assets load only on pages with a gallery, server-side rendered HTML (SEO friendly).

Premium

3pika Gallery Premium is a separate edition with more layouts and tools:

  • Masonry, Justified and Slider layouts
  • Multi-select filters, item counts, deep links
  • Dots pagination and infinite scroll
  • Lightbox zoom, slideshow, fullscreen, social share, download
  • YouTube, Vimeo and MP4 videos inside galleries; MP4 and WebM videos can play muted in a loop right in the grid
  • Watermark overlay and right-click protection
  • Custom CSS per gallery, duplicate, import and export
  • 10 hover effects

More at https://gallery.3pika.com
sections.installation:
1. Install the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload, or upload the 3pika-gallery folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to 3pika Gallery → Create New Gallery, add images and filters, save.
  4. Paste the shortcode [3pika_gallery id="123"] anywhere, or use the Elementor / WPBakery / Gutenberg element.
sections.faq:
Can I override the columns per page?

Yes: [3pika_gallery id="123" columns="4" layout="grid" pagination="loadmore" per_page="8" filter="nature"].

How do I customise the markup?

Copy templates/gallery.php to yourtheme/3pika-gallery/gallery.php.

Galleries loaded via AJAX / popups don’t initialise

Enable “Always load gallery assets” in 3pika Gallery → Settings → General, or call window.TPIKA.init() after injecting the HTML.

Do my galleries stay when I switch to Premium?

Yes. Premium is installed over the free edition and uses the same galleries and settings.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Tested with WordPress 7.2.
  • The Gutenberg block uses block API version 3 and shows its preview correctly inside the editor canvas.
  • The gallery builder no longer uses a jQuery function that jQuery 4 removes.

1.4.1

  • The gallery returned by the shortcode, the Gutenberg block and the template function is escaped before WordPress prints it.

1.4.0

  • Prepared for the WordPress.org plugin directory: longer prefix for everything the plugin registers, output escaped where it is printed, scripts and styles loaded through the WordPress enqueue functions.
  • New: Mosaic and List can be chosen in the Elementor widget, the WPBakery element and the Gutenberg block.
  • New: the gallery preview opens without the admin bar.
  • Requires WordPress 6.2 or newer.

1.3.2

  • Free edition: unlimited filters, 5 and 6 columns and the dropdown filter style are now included.

1.3.1

  • New: “Go Premium” link next to the version on the Plugins screen.

1.3.0

  • Free and Premium are now two editions of the plugin. Premium is installed over Free, galleries and settings stay.

1.2.0

  • New: translated into 85 languages. The plugin follows the WordPress site language automatically (Settings → General → Site Language).
  • New: the default “All” and “Load more” labels are shown in the site language.

1.1.1

  • New: styled filter dropdown (desktop and mobile) instead of the browser’s native select.
  • Fix: “Underline” and “Text only” filters no longer show a box or shadow around the active filter.
  • Fix: admin buttons and icons keep their round shape when clicked (WordPress 7).

1.1.0

  • New admin design: full-width, visual pickers for layout, hover effect, hover icon, filter style, mobile filters and pagination.
  • New layouts: Mosaic and List. Hover icon (magnifier, plus, expand, eye, link).
  • Filters: 8 styles, size, shadow toggle, 6 mobile behaviours, text color with automatic contrast, colors for all filters at once.
  • Builder: shift-click range select, file names, filter view pills, deselect / delete selected, chunked loading for large galleries.
  • Corner radius per corner, more sort orders, accent color presets, responsive preview in a real iframe.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
